strategy.primary: Black-spell lifegain: Sol'kanar and Demon's Horn trigger on every black spell (on every spell with Painter's Servant naming black), and the gains feed Exquisite Blood / Bloodthirsty Conqueror loops with Vito, Blight-Priest, Enduring Tenacity or Starscape Cleric.
strategy.secondary: Swamp matters (Blanket of Night, Urborg, Cabal Coffers, Crypt Ghast) for swampwalk and mana; Painter + Grindstone; wheels with Sheoldred and Underworld Dreams.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Sol'kanar the Swamp King
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Swampwalk (This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Swamp.)
Whenever a player casts a black spell, you gain 1 life.
